environments.description: Per-environment configuration. Required for semver-per-env and calver-per-env strategies.

remote_metadata.description: Whether content generators fetch PR/MR metadata (author handle, PR number) from the platform API to enrich the changelog/release-notes. 'required': fetch and fail if unavailable. 'optional' (default): fetch when possible, otherwise generate without it and warn. 'disabled': never fetch (offline, no token). Governs both changelog and release-notes generation. The --offline flag forces 'disabled' for a single run.

tickets.description: Issue-tracker links. Each entry's regex is matched in commit messages (subject/body/footer) and rendered as a link in the changelog and release notes. git-cliff only.

pattern.description: Regex matching ticket IDs, e.g. [A-Z]+-[0-9]+. The first capture group (or the full match if there is no group) becomes {ticket}; the link label is always the full match.

types.description: Restricts which conventional-commit type words 'heraut commit verify' accepts. Replaces (does not extend) the default list when set: feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor, test, style, perf, ci, build.

scopes.description: Optional scope allow-list used only by 'heraut commit create' to offer a scope picker. NOT enforced by 'heraut commit verify'/'check'. Omit for a free-text scope step.

CommitLint.description: Configures 'heraut commit verify''s type allow-list (ADR-0027). Optional — omit entirely to use the default list.

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix (e.g. "v"). Set to "" for bare version tags.

initial_version.description: Version used when no tags exist yet. SemVer strategies only.

bump.description: Bump mode. "auto" infers from conventional commits. SemVer strategies only.

format.description: CalVer format string (e.g. "YYYY.MM.PATCH"). Required for calver strategies.

sprint.description: Current sprint counter. Required when format contains SPRINT. Advance with heraut version sprint bump.

tag_format.description: Common tag format template for per-env strategies (e.g. "{env}/{version}").

tag_type.description: Git tag type. "annotated" (default) creates tags with a tagger, timestamp, and message. "lightweight" creates bare ref tags.

config.description: Path to a generator-specific config file.

tag_pattern.description: Git tag glob for filtering commits (e.g. "dev/*").

remote.description: Explicit metadata-only remote for git-cliff PR/author enrichment. Changelog only — release notes already resolve this from release.platforms and reject this block. git-cliff only. See ADR-0026.

Remote.description: Explicit, metadata-only remote for git-cliff PR/author enrichment. Unlike release.platforms, this never grants publish capability.

project.description: GitLab project path (namespace[/subgroup]/repo). Required for type: gitlab. For type: azure_devops, "organization/project" (required) — matches git-cliff's own azure_devops "owner" shape.

repository.description: GitHub repository (owner/repo). Required for type: github. For type: azure_devops, the Azure DevOps repository name (required).

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the API token. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN / GITLAB_TOKEN / AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN depending on type.

api_url.description: API/web host override. Azure DevOps Server (on-prem) only; defaults to https://dev.azure.com.

assets.description: Glob patterns for files to attach to the release, applied to all platforms. Globs are expanded at release time; a pattern matching nothing emits a warning but does not abort the release. If a platform entry also defines assets, the platform-level list takes full precedence for that platform (no merging).

name.description: Unique identifier for this platform entry within its release.platforms list (top-level or a single environment override). Required.

draft.description: Create as draft release. GitHub only.

base_url.description: Web base URL of the platform instance (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com for a self-hosted instance). Defaults to https://github.com / https://gitlab.com. Self-hosted (non-default) values are supported — see ADR-0025.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the API token.

assets.description: Platform-specific glob patterns for files to attach to the release. When set, overrides release.assets entirely for this platform. Omit to inherit release.assets.

EnvRelease.description: Per-environment release overrides. Absent fields inherit from root release.

notes.description: Override release notes generator for this environment.

Environment.description: Per-environment configuration. Versioning fields drive version resolution; content fields override changelog/release.

branch.description: Branch this environment is operated from. heraut refuses any --env command for this environment unless the current git branch matches (override with --force).

source.description: Source environment for promote bump mode.

disable_changelog.description: Disable changelog generation for this environment.

disable_notes.description: Disable release notes for this environment.

changelog.description: Override changelog generator for this environment.

release.description: Override release settings for this environment.
